title: Extension by zero of abelian Zariski sheaves is exact
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme, $U\subseteq X$ an open subscheme, and $X_{\rm Zar}$, $U_{\rm Zar}$ the small Zariski sites of $X$ and of $U$ [def-sc-zariski-site] (the objects of $U_{\rm Zar}$ are the opens $W\subseteq U$, which are also objects of $X_{\rm Zar}$, and a family of opens of $W$ is a covering of $W$ in $U_{\rm Zar}$ if and only if it is one in $X_{\rm Zar}$). Let $\textit{Ab}(X_{\rm Zar})$, $\textit{Ab}(U_{\rm Zar})$ be the abelian categories of abelian sheaves on these sites [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. For $\mathcal G\in\textit{Ab}(X_{\rm Zar})$ let $\mathcal G|_U\in\textit{Ab}(U_{\rm Zar})$ be the abelian sheaf $W\mapsto\mathcal G(W)$ ($W\subseteq U$ open) with the restriction maps of $\mathcal G$, and for a morphism $\psi$ of $\textit{Ab}(X_{\rm Zar})$ let $(\psi|_U)_W=\psi_W$. For $\mathcal F\in\textit{Ab}(U_{\rm Zar})$ let $j_{p!}\mathcal F$ be the presheaf of abelian groups on $X_{\rm Zar}$ with $(j_{p!}\mathcal F)(V)=\mathcal F(V)$ if $V\subseteq U$ and $(j_{p!}\mathcal F)(V)=0$ if $V\not\subseteq U$ ($V\subseteq X$ open), whose restriction map along $V'\subseteq V$ is the restriction map of $\mathcal F$ if $V\subseteq U$ (then also $V'\subseteq U$) and $0$ otherwise; a morphism $\alpha:\mathcal F\to\mathcal F'$ of $\textit{Ab}(U_{\rm Zar})$ gives $j_{p!}\alpha$, equal to $\alpha_V$ for $V\subseteq U$ and to $0$ otherwise. Let $\theta_{\mathcal F}:j_{p!}\mathcal F\to j_!\mathcal F$ be the sheafification of $j_{p!}\mathcal F$ as a presheaf of abelian groups on the site $X_{\rm Zar}$ [def-weil-pbc-sheafification], and $j_!\alpha:j_!\mathcal F\to j_!\mathcal F'$ the unique morphism with $j_!\alpha\circ\theta_{\mathcal F}=\theta_{\mathcal F'}\circ j_{p!}\alpha$; $j_!\mathcal F$ is the *extension of $\mathcal F$ by zero*. Then $j_!:\textit{Ab}(U_{\rm Zar})\to\textit{Ab}(X_{\rm Zar})$ is an exact functor of abelian categories: it is additive and carries every short exact sequence $0\to\mathcal F'\to\mathcal F\to\mathcal F''\to0$ of $\textit{Ab}(U_{\rm Zar})$ to a short exact sequence $0\to j_!\mathcal F'\to j_!\mathcal F\to j_!\mathcal F''\to0$ of $\textit{Ab}(X_{\rm Zar})$ [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence]; in particular it carries monomorphisms to monomorphisms.

source.place: Modules on Sites, Lemma 03DJ (label lemma-extension-by-zero-exact, line 2160) and its proof (right exact as a left adjoint, Categories Lemma 0039 categories-lemma-exact-adjoint; injective maps go to injective maps since j_{p!} is injective sectionwise and sheafification is exact), for the ringed site (X_Zar, Z) and the object U

proof.text: *Step 1 (additivity, and $j_!$ on morphisms is sheafification).* By [lem-weil-pbc-zariski-extension-by-zero-adjunction] (1), $\mathcal F\mapsto j_!\mathcal F$, $\alpha\mapsto j_!\alpha$ is an additive functor $\textit{Ab}(U_{\rm Zar})\to\textit{Ab}(X_{\rm Zar})$; in particular $j_!0=0$ for zero morphisms. Both categories are abelian [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] (1). Write $\#:\textit{PAb}(X_{\rm Zar})\to\textit{Ab}(X_{\rm Zar})$ for sheafification on the site $X_{\rm Zar}$ [def-weil-pbc-sheafification], with unit $\theta_{\mathcal P}:\mathcal P\to\mathcal P^\#$; for a morphism $\varphi:\mathcal P\to\mathcal P'$ of presheaves, $\varphi^\#$ is by definition the unique morphism of sheaves with $\varphi^\#\circ\theta_{\mathcal P}=\theta_{\mathcal P'}\circ\varphi$ (universal property of $\theta_{\mathcal P}$ applied to $\theta_{\mathcal P'}\circ\varphi$). Since $j_!\mathcal F=(j_{p!}\mathcal F)^\#$ with $\theta_{\mathcal F}=\theta_{j_{p!}\mathcal F}$, and $j_!\alpha$ is characterized by the same equation, $j_!\alpha=(j_{p!}\alpha)^\#$.

source.place: Modules on Sites, Lemma 03DJ (label lemma-extension-by-zero-exact, line 2160), proof

proof.text: *Step 2 (a monomorphism of $\textit{Ab}(U_{\rm Zar})$ is injective on every section).* Let $\alpha:\mathcal F'\to\mathcal F$ be a monomorphism of $\textit{Ab}(U_{\rm Zar})$. By [lem-weil-pbc-sheafification-exact] (1) on the site $U_{\rm Zar}$, a kernel of $\alpha$ is $k:\mathcal K\to\mathcal F'$ with $\mathcal K(W)=\operatorname{Ker}(\alpha_W)$ ($W\subseteq U$ open) and $k_W$ the inclusion. Then $\alpha\circ k=0=\alpha\circ 0$, so $k=0$ because $\alpha$ is a monomorphism; hence each inclusion $k_W:\operatorname{Ker}(\alpha_W)\to\mathcal F'(W)$ is zero, i.e. $\operatorname{Ker}(\alpha_W)=0$: every $\alpha_W$ is injective.

source.place: Modules on Sites, Lemma 03DJ (label lemma-extension-by-zero-exact, line 2160), proof

proof.text: *Step 3 ($j_!$ carries monomorphisms to monomorphisms).* Let $\alpha:\mathcal F'\to\mathcal F$ be a monomorphism of $\textit{Ab}(U_{\rm Zar})$. By Step 2 and the definition of $j_{p!}$, every component $(j_{p!}\alpha)_V$ ($V\subseteq X$ open) is injective: it is $\alpha_V$ if $V\subseteq U$ and $0\to0$ otherwise. Hence the zero presheaf $0$ with the zero map $0\to j_{p!}\mathcal F'$ is a kernel of $j_{p!}\alpha$ in $\textit{PAb}(X_{\rm Zar})$: its composite with $j_{p!}\alpha$ is $0$, and a morphism $t:\mathcal T\to j_{p!}\mathcal F'$ with $j_{p!}\alpha\circ t=0$ has $(j_{p!}\alpha)_V\circ t_V=0$ for all $V$ (composition and zero morphisms of presheaves are sectionwise, [lem-weil-pbc-abelian-presheaves-evaluation-exact]), so $t_V=0$ by injectivity, i.e. $t=0$, which factors uniquely through $0$. A kernel is a finite limit (of the diagram $j_{p!}\mathcal F'\rightrightarrows j_{p!}\mathcal F$ given by $j_{p!}\alpha$ and $0$), and so is the zero object (the limit of the empty diagram, a terminal object of the abelian category $\textit{PAb}(X_{\rm Zar})$). By [lem-weil-pbc-sheafification-exact] (2) the functor $\#$ commutes with finite limits; hence $0^\#$ is a terminal, hence zero, object of the abelian category $\textit{Ab}(X_{\rm Zar})$ [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] (1), and $0^\#\to j_!\mathcal F'$ is a kernel of $(j_{p!}\alpha)^\#=j_!\alpha$ (Step 1); also $\#$ carries the zero morphism to the zero morphism, since $0^\#$ is a zero object and the zero morphism factors through $0$. Now if $\beta,\gamma:\mathcal T\to j_!\mathcal F'$ satisfy $j_!\alpha\circ\beta=j_!\alpha\circ\gamma$, then $j_!\alpha\circ(\beta-\gamma)=0$ (composition is bilinear), so $\beta-\gamma$ factors through the zero object $0^\#$ and is $0$: $\beta=\gamma$. So $j_!\alpha$ is a monomorphism.

source.place: Modules on Sites, Lemma 03DJ (label lemma-extension-by-zero-exact, line 2160), proof

proof.text: *Step 4 ($j_!$ carries a cokernel to a cokernel).* Let $0\to\mathcal F'\xrightarrow{\alpha}\mathcal F\xrightarrow{\beta}\mathcal F''\to0$ be a short exact sequence of $\textit{Ab}(U_{\rm Zar})$ [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence]: $\beta\circ\alpha=0$, $\alpha$ is a monomorphism, $\beta$ an epimorphism and the complex $\mathcal F'\to\mathcal F\to\mathcal F''$ is exact at $\mathcal F$. By [lem-weil-pbc-abelian-exact-epi-cokernel] (a), $\beta$ is a cokernel of $\alpha$. A cokernel of $\alpha$ is the same as a colimit [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit] of the diagram $D$ on the category $I$ with two objects $a,b$ and two parallel non-identity arrows $a\rightrightarrows b$, sent to $\alpha,0:\mathcal F'\rightrightarrows\mathcal F$: a cocone $(\mathcal M,\mu_a,\mu_b)$ on $D$ has $\mu_a=\mu_b\circ\alpha=\mu_b\circ0=0$, so it is the same as a morphism $\mu_b:\mathcal F\to\mathcal M$ with $\mu_b\circ\alpha=0$, and the colimit property is the universal property of the cokernel; the cocone is $(\mathcal F'',0,\beta)$. By [lem-weil-pbc-zariski-extension-by-zero-adjunction] (2), $j_!$ is left adjoint to the restriction functor $\mathcal G\mapsto\mathcal G|_U$, $\psi\mapsto\psi|_U$ (a functor, since its components are those of $\mathcal G$ and $\psi$), through bijections natural in both variables. By [lem-weil-pbc-left-adjoint-preserves-colimits], $(j_!\mathcal F'',j_!0,j_!\beta)$ is a colimit of $j_!\circ D$, which is the diagram $j_!\alpha,j_!0:j_!\mathcal F'\rightrightarrows j_!\mathcal F$; since $j_!0=0$ (Step 1), by the same translation $j_!\beta$ is a cokernel of $j_!\alpha$ in $\textit{Ab}(X_{\rm Zar})$.

source.place: Modules on Sites, Lemma 03DJ (label lemma-extension-by-zero-exact, line 2160), proof: right exact as a left adjoint, Categories Lemma 0039 (categories-lemma-exact-adjoint)

proof.text: *Step 5 (conclusion).* For a short exact sequence $0\to\mathcal F'\xrightarrow{\alpha}\mathcal F\xrightarrow{\beta}\mathcal F''\to0$ of $\textit{Ab}(U_{\rm Zar})$, $j_!\alpha$ is a monomorphism (Step 3, $\alpha$ being a monomorphism [def-weil-pbc-exact-sequence]) and $j_!\beta$ is a cokernel of $j_!\alpha$ (Step 4). By [lem-weil-pbc-abelian-exact-epi-cokernel] (c) in the abelian category $\textit{Ab}(X_{\rm Zar})$ [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] (1), $0\to j_!\mathcal F'\xrightarrow{j_!\alpha}j_!\mathcal F\xrightarrow{j_!\beta}j_!\mathcal F''\to0$ is a short exact sequence. With the additivity of Step 1 this is the exactness of $j_!$; the clause on monomorphisms is Step 3.
